title: FAR-DPO: Feasibility-Aware and Robust Direct Preference Optimization for Cyclic Peptide Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.19808v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cyclic peptides are emerging as promising molecular scaffolds in drug discovery due to their high binding affinity and structural stability. However, extending generative models from linear to cyclic peptide design remains challenging, as cyclization sharply restricts the feasible design space through coupled geometric and biophysical constraints. Moreover, limited training data has led existing approaches to rely largely on zero-shot generation or post hoc filtering, resulting in low yields of feasible designs and limited control over multi-objective trade-offs. To address these limitations, we propose FAR-DPO (Feasibility-Aware and Robust Direct Preference Optimization), an architecture-agnostic framework that steers generative models toward structurally and biophysically feasible cyclic peptide designs, particularly for challenging targets. translated_title: FAR-DPO：面向环肽设计的可行性感知与鲁棒直接偏好优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19808v1 公告类型：新 摘要：环肽因其高结合亲和力和结构稳定性，正成为药物发现中前景广阔的分子支架。然而，将生成模型从线性肽设计扩展到环肽设计仍具挑战性，因为环化通过耦合的几何和生物物理约束急剧缩小了可行设计空间。此外，有限训练数据导致现有方法主要依赖零样本生成或事后过滤，导致可行设计产出率低，且对多目标权衡的控制有限。为解决这些限制，我们提出FAR-DPO（可行性感知与鲁棒直接偏好优化），一种架构无关的框架，引导生成模型朝向结构上和生物物理上可行的环肽设计，尤其针对具有挑战性的靶标。FAR-DPO整合了可行性感知的偏好构建与难度感知的群体鲁棒优化。
tldr: FAR-DPO通过结合可行性感知偏好构建与难度感知的鲁棒优化，提出了一种架构无关的框架，显著提高了环肽设计在挑战性靶标上的可行性和多目标控制能力。
en_tdlr: FAR-DPO introduces an architecture-agnostic framework that integrates feasibility-aware preference construction with difficulty-aware robust optimization, significantly enhancing the feasibility and multi-objective control of cyclic peptide design for challenging targets.
